name: mwl-timesheet-css
description: Build + edge deployment for the vanilla-JS SPA: purged Tailwind CSS, static render of templates/*.html into dist/, and the Cloudflare Worker that serves dist/ and proxies /api/* to the on-prem Flask origin.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:static
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
